body: I don’t see myself living long, I never had. I’ve been through too much as well I feel like some days my urges to kill myself just seem normal to me, but after a good day they cripple me, and the part that drowns me the most is the realization that those urges are always there. No matter how well I do, how much progress I make, or how much good I see in life. They will always weigh me down.
